source: ai-cluster-reliability audited catalog (expert review 2026-10-09; remap/remap-latest/references/expert-review-2026-10-09/inputs.json, revision event-budget-v3-sdc1.4-reviewed-85): 54 events = 18 hardware domains × {interruption, sub-health, silent}, business-impact FIT per card-hour (the ReMAP / reference basis). The per-domain values are expert priors pending audit (“PRIOR, keeping the USER class totals and the V4 coarse grouping”) under fixed class totals: hard 3,333.3 / slow 69.0 / silent 48.3 FIT per card, normalised so that 10,000 cards have a hard-interruption MTBF of 30 h; RoCE switches and links take the UB analogues. Reconciled 2026-10-21: all 54 values equal inputs.json to 1e-9.

rateBasis.zh: 每十亿 NPU 等效运行暴露小时的业务影响事件；非物理器件 FIT
rateBasis.en: business-impact events per 10⁹ NPU-equivalent running exposure hours; not physical device FIT

anchor.note: class totals fixed by the user (USER), split over domains by the expert review; CORE carries 85 % of the silent class, 12 silent ids are zero by the review

catalog.confidenceNote: every event is tagged assumed: the catalog itself labels each value 待审计先验 / 经验先验 (prior pending audit) or 用户审计建模假设 (user modelling assumption), none is a vendor or fleet measurement
